scope: Homepage decorative atmosphere only; existing routes, market data, logo, hero height and working page proportions remain unchanged.

direction.name: Signal into focus
direction.identity: Original ribbon SVGs and exact-color Three.js front faces remain authoritative
direction.search: Existing _StockSearch partial and working stock routes
direction.typography: Existing self-hosted Manrope; no new font or runtime dependency

media.output_policy: No runtime URLs, empty media elements, frame loaders, or CSP changes until actual media passes review.

timing.coordinate: Normalized travel from hero top reaching sticky header to hero bottom reaching sticky header. No added pin spacer or page height.
timing.desktop_active_travel: Existing hero height, about 0.56–0.8 viewport heights depending on viewport; measure at integration.
timing.mobile_active_travel: Existing automatic hero height, measured on device; no extra travel.

beats.copy: Current heading, description, search and two actions are visible from initial HTML.
beats.camera: Locked. Original logo in its separate right-hand stage.

beats.copy: No additional copy. Existing hero content remains in normal flow.
beats.camera: Locked; light moves on the right. Mobile uses quieter crop, no heavy full-screen stage.

beats.copy: Existing snapshot and research links enter naturally as hero leaves.
beats.camera: Locked, motion decelerates; no cut between independently generated scenes.

timing.boundary_rule: Half-open intervals [start,end), final interval inclusive at 1. Reverse scrolling uses the same mapping. Hold freezes an accepted frame; actual frame indexes remain null until extraction is verified.

delivery_budgets.memory_note: At 1280×720 RGBA, one decoded frame is about 3.52 MiB; ten are about 35.2 MiB. Compressed size does not measure decoded memory.
delivery_budgets.fallback: Existing SVG and readable HTML, no sequence fetch for reduced motion, saved pause or Save-Data.
delivery_budgets.failure_policy: Keep last useful frame or poster, cap retries, ignore stale responses, stop offscreen/hidden, release resources on teardown.

acceptance.seams: One continuous clip per theme avoids cross-clip joins. Inspect all beats and full playback before extraction.
acceptance.brand: No generated logo, financial chart, market price or text. Original SVG unchanged.
acceptance.data: No financial data may appear in decorative media.
acceptance.interaction: Search, keyboard actions, native scrolling both directions, pause, reduced motion, Save-Data, resize, failed media, offscreen cleanup.
acceptance.production: Not deployed; no generation output exists.
